old: A browser upload that fails on a network interruption shows a Resume button; an upload-queue overload shows a 503-slowdown-spam message.
new: A browser upload that fails on a network interruption shows a Resume button; a failed upload can instead show a 503-slowdown-spam message, for which the page gives no cause.
